title: Cantor's Characterization of the Rationals
description: ℚ is, up to order-isomorphism, the unique countable dense linear order without endpoints (Cantor 1895). Uses the back-and-forth method.

insights: Mathlib provides Order.iso_of_countable_dense which directly proves the characterization
Order.PartialIso captures finite partial isomorphisms (building blocks of back-and-forth)
Order.exists_between_finsets is the key density extension lemma
exact_mod_cast and simp [Int.cast_le] have API differences in Docker Mathlib v4.26.0
For Fin n → ℚ strict monotonicity, use Nat.cast_lt.mpr with explicit show
For ↪o map_rel_iff', use change + exact Int.cast_le/Nat.cast_le
builtItems: cantor_characterization: α ≃o ℚ for any countable dense linear order without endpoints
countable_dense_linear_orders_iso: general form for any two such orders
midpoint_between, two_between, three_between: density propagation results
knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: Full formalization of Cantor's characterization theorem. 0 sorries, 0 axioms. All theorems proved using Mathlib's Order.iso_of_countable_dense. Fixed API compatibility issues with Docker Mathlib v4.26.0.
